title: Don't Buy Oracle Stock Until You Watch This! 🚨
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Oracle is the worst-financed hyperscaler, spending more than it brings in despite ~$600bn+ OpenAI backlog.
Hyperscaler bonds yielding ~7-8% compete with Treasuries, helping push US yields higher.

calls.reason: Force majeure on Project Jupiter (New Mexico data center), heavy leverage and Larry Ellison pledging Oracle stock as collateral add uncertainty; growth strong but momentum terrible near 52-week lows.

notes: Host not invested; 'considered it'. No explicit buy/sell. Title 'Don't Buy Oracle Until You Watch This' -> cautious/mixed. Date from listing (talks of live session Monday, so weekend recording).
